description: Stall-speed data pack for the 8 priority aircraft. Best available primary and high-quality secondary sources. All numbers graded. CAS/EAS still rare.
notes: Primary German factory stall tables (Rechlin Kennblätter with full numbers) remain scarce in open sources. British captured-aircraft reports and US pilot’s notes are the strongest available anchors.

p51d.configuration: gear and flaps up, no external load
p51d.notes: Mild stall. Elevator buffet warning 3-4 mph above stall. Recovery normal.

p47d.source: Pilot’s notes + NACA RM L8A06 (P-47D-30 flying qualities)
p47d.notes: Satisfactory in clean/glide/landing. Approach and wave-off weaker. Tested around 12500-13200 lb.

spitfire5.source: NACA WR L-353 Stalling Characteristics of the Supermarine Spitfire VA (Vensel & Phillips, 1942)
spitfire5.notes: Good buffet warning several mph above minimum speed. Wing tips stall first. Motions not violent. Absolute IAS table not published in open extract.

spitfire1.notes: Flaps and undercarriage up. Early production weights.

bf109e.notes: Flaps and undercarriage up for 75 mph figure. Slats open ~20 mph above stall.

bf109g2.notes: IAS only. No primary Rechlin CAS table located in open sources.

fw190a8.source: AFDU captured Fw 190 notes (approx. 110 mph clean) + secondary
fw190a8.notes: Sudden stall with little warning in clean configuration. Controls effective until stall.

fw190d9.notes: Similar behavior to A-8. Thin primary data.

naca_and_primary_reports: NACA WR L-566 - XP-51 flying qualities and stalling characteristics (CLmax 1.5-1.9)
NACA RM L8A06 - P-47D-30 longitudinal stability and stalling characteristics
NACA WR L-353 - Spitfire VA stalling characteristics
AN 01-60JE-1 - P-51D Pilot’s Flight Operating Instructions
RAE/AFDU captured Bf 109E and Fw 190 reports
remaining_gaps: No clean CAS/EAS at matched mass for most aircraft
German primary stall tables (Rechlin Kennblätter with full numbers) not located in open sources
Spitfire V absolute IAS table still sparse
No full P-51D NACA stall report equivalent to the XP-51 one
